# secobserve_settings (Resource)

Manages the SecObserve instance settings singleton (`GET`/`PATCH /api/settings/1/`), superuser-only.

There is exactly one settings record, created implicitly by SecObserve and never deleted: `terraform destroy` on this resource only removes it from Terraform state, it does not reset anything on the server. Every attribute is `Optional` with the server's own default, so omitting an attribute here does not clobber a value set outside Terraform -- but this also means a fresh `terraform apply` with everything omitted still pins every setting to that default from then on.

Import with any id, for example `terraform import secobserve_settings.this 1`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every attribute is optional and defaults to SecObserve's own default, so
# only override what actually needs to differ from a fresh install. There is
# exactly one instance of this resource per SecObserve backend.
resource "secobserve_settings" "this" {
  base_url_frontend = "https://secobserve.example.com"

  security_gate_threshold_critical = 0
  security_gate_threshold_high     = 5

  branch_housekeeping_active             = true
  branch_housekeeping_keep_inactive_days = 60

  feature_general_rules_need_approval = true
  risk_acceptance_expiry_days         = 90

  password_validator_minimum_length = 12
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_import_crontab_hour` (Number) Hour (UTC) automatic API imports runs at.
- `api_import_crontab_minute` (Number) Minute (UTC) automatic API imports runs at.
- `background_epss_import_crontab_hour` (Number) Hour (UTC) the EPSS/cvss-bt import runs at.
- `background_epss_import_crontab_minute` (Number) Minute (UTC) the EPSS/cvss-bt import runs at.
- `background_product_metrics_interval_minutes` (Number) How often product metrics are recalculated, in minutes.
- `base_url_frontend` (String) Base URL of the frontend, used to build links in notifications.

~> Unlike every other URL setting here, SecObserve rejects an explicit empty string for this one (`This field may not be blank`), so it cannot be cleared back to "" once set.
- `branch_housekeeping_active` (Boolean)
- `branch_housekeeping_crontab_hour` (Number) Hour (UTC) branch housekeeping runs at.
- `branch_housekeeping_crontab_minute` (Number) Minute (UTC) branch housekeeping runs at.
- `branch_housekeeping_exempt_branches` (String) Instance-wide default regular expression exempting branches from housekeeping.
- `branch_housekeeping_keep_inactive_days` (Number) Instance-wide default days a branch may stay inactive before deletion.
- `email_from` (String)
- `exception_email_to` (String) Comma-separated email addresses for exception notifications.
- `exception_ms_teams_webhook` (String) Microsoft Teams webhook for exception notifications.
- `exception_rate_limit` (Number) Seconds before the same exception can trigger another notification.
- `exception_slack_webhook` (String) Slack webhook for exception notifications.
- `exploit_information_max_age_years` (Number) Maximum CVE age considered for exploit-information enrichment, in years.
- `feature_automatic_api_import` (Boolean)
- `feature_automatic_osv_scanning` (Boolean)
- `feature_automatic_vulnerablecode_scanning` (Boolean)
- `feature_cross_scanner_deduplication` (Boolean)
- `feature_disable_user_login` (Boolean)
- `feature_exploit_information` (Boolean)
- `feature_general_rules_need_approval` (Boolean) Require approval for general rules. A rule created while this is enabled stays inactive until somebody other than its author approves it, and SecObserve rejects self-approval -- the provider can never approve its own rules.
- `feature_license_management` (Boolean) Enable license management.

~> SecObserve force-enables this whenever `feature_automatic_osv_scanning` is `true` (the default), regardless of what is sent here in the same request. Since Terraform forbids a provider from applying a different value than the one planned, `false` here is **rejected at plan time** rather than accepted and silently overridden -- set `feature_automatic_osv_scanning = false` too, or drop this attribute.
- `feature_show_product_header_chips` (Boolean)
- `feature_vex` (Boolean)
- `internal_users` (String) Comma-separated regular expressions matched against an OIDC user's email to decide whether they are internal. Evaluated only when a user is first created; changing it does not reclassify existing users.
- `jwt_validity_duration_superuser` (Number) Hours a superuser's frontend JWT stays valid.
- `jwt_validity_duration_user` (Number) Hours a regular user's frontend JWT stays valid.
- `license_import_crontab_hour` (Number) Hour (UTC) the license import runs at.
- `license_import_crontab_minute` (Number) Minute (UTC) the license import runs at.
- `observation_count_from_metrics` (Boolean)
- `observation_title_notification_email_to` (String) Comma-separated email addresses for observation-title notifications.
- `observation_title_notification_min_priority` (Number) Only notify about a new observation title with at least this priority (1-99).
- `observation_title_notification_min_severity` (String) Only notify about a new observation title of at least this severity. One of `Unknown`, `None`, `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, `Critical`. The empty string disables the severity condition.
- `observation_title_notification_ms_teams_webhook` (String) Microsoft Teams webhook for observation-title notifications.
- `observation_title_notification_parser_type` (String) Only notify about a new observation title from this scanner category. One of `SCA`, `SAST`, `DAST`, `IAST`, `Secrets`, `Infrastructure`, `Other`, `Manual`.
- `observation_title_notification_slack_webhook` (String) Slack webhook for observation-title notifications.
- `observation_title_notification_status_list` (Set of String) Only notify about a new observation title in one of these statuses. Any of `Open`, `Affected`, `Resolved`, `Duplicate`, `False positive`, `In review`, `Not affected`, `Not security`, `Risk accepted`. An empty set disables the status condition.
- `oidc_clock_skew` (Number) Seconds of clock skew tolerated when validating OIDC token timestamps.
- `password_validator_attribute_similarity` (Boolean)
- `password_validator_common_passwords` (Boolean)
- `password_validator_minimum_length` (Number) Minimum password length.
- `password_validator_not_numeric` (Boolean)
- `periodic_task_max_entries` (Number) How many run records to keep per periodic task.
- `risk_acceptance_expiry_crontab_hour` (Number) Hour (UTC) the risk acceptance expiry check runs at.
- `risk_acceptance_expiry_crontab_minute` (Number) Minute (UTC) the risk acceptance expiry check runs at.
- `risk_acceptance_expiry_days` (Number) Instance-wide default days before an accepted risk expires. `0` means never.
- `security_gate_active` (Boolean) Instance-wide default for whether the security gate is evaluated.
- `security_gate_threshold_critical` (Number) Instance-wide default critical-severity threshold.
- `security_gate_threshold_high` (Number) Instance-wide default high-severity threshold.
- `security_gate_threshold_low` (Number) Instance-wide default low-severity threshold.
- `security_gate_threshold_medium` (Number) Instance-wide default medium-severity threshold.
- `security_gate_threshold_none` (Number) Instance-wide default `None`-severity threshold.
- `security_gate_threshold_unknown` (Number) Instance-wide default unknown-severity threshold.
- `vex_justification_style` (String) VEX justification vocabulary to use: one of `CSAF/OpenVEX`, `CycloneDX`.
- `vulnerablecode_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for the VulnerableCode instance. Encrypted at rest; SecObserve returns it in plaintext to a superuser caller.
- `vulnerablecode_base_url` (String) Base URL of the VulnerableCode instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Always `1`: SecObserve keeps exactly one settings record and the API hardcodes its id.
